input: جواهر الأسرار فی معارج الأسفار لمن اراد ان یتقرّب بالله المقتدر الغفّار فهنیاً للأبرار الّذین یشربون من هذه الأنهار.
output: The essence of the divine mysteries in the journeys of ascent set forth for those who long to draw nigh unto God, the Almighty, the Ever-Forgiving—blessed be the righteous that quaff from these crystal streams.
prediction: The jewels of the mysteries in the ascents of the journeys are for him who desireth to draw nigh unto God, the All-Powerful, the Forgiving. Blessed are the righteous who drink from these rivers.

output: He is the Exalted, the Most High.
prediction: He is the Most Exalted, the Most High.

input: یا ایّها السّالک فی سبل العدل و النّاظر الی طلعة الفضل.
output: O thou who treadest the path of justice and beholdest the countenance of mercy.
prediction: O thou who art a wayfarer in the paths of justice, and gazest upon the countenance of grace!

input: قد بلغ کتابک و عرفت سؤالک و سمعت لحنات قلبک فی سرادق فؤادک.
output: Thine epistle was received, thy question was noted, and the sweet accents of thy soul were heard from the inmost chambers of thy heart.
prediction: Thy Book hath reached its destination, and I have come to know Thy supplication, and I have heard the melodies of Thy heart in the tabernacle of Thy breast.

input: اذاً قد رفعت سحاب الارادة لتمطر علیک من امطار الحکمة لتأخذ عنک کلّ ما اخذت من قبل و تقلّبک عن جهات الضّدیّة الی مکمن الأحدیّة و تصلک الی شریعة القدسیّة.
output: Whereupon the clouds of the Divine Will were raised to rain upon thee the outpourings of heavenly wisdom, to divest thee of all that thou hadst acquired aforetime, to draw thee from the realms of contradiction unto the retreats of oneness, and to lead thee to the sacred streams of His Law.
prediction: Verily, I have raised the cloud of Thy will, that it may rain down upon Thee the showers of wisdom, that Thou mayest take from it all that Thou hast received before, and be turned from the directions of duality unto the essence of oneness, and be guided unto the law of sanctity.

input: لتشرب عنها و تستریح نفسک فیها و یسکن عطشک و یبرد فؤادک و تکون من الّذینهم کانوا الیوم بنورالله لمهتدین.
output: Perchance thou mayest quaff therefrom, repose therein, quench thy thirst, refresh thy soul, and be numbered with those whom the light of God hath guided aright in this day.
prediction: That thou mayest drink thereof and find thy soul at rest therein, and thy thirst be quenched, and thy heart be cooled, and that thou mayest be of those who, this day, have been guided by the light of God.

input: ولو انّی فی تلک الأیّام الّتی احاطتنی کلاب الأرض و سبع البلاد خفیت فی وکر سرّی و اکون ممنوعاً عن اظهار ما اعطانی الله من بدائع علمه و جواهر حکمته و شؤونات قدرته
output: Encompassed as I am at this time by the dogs of the earth and the beasts of every land, concealed as I remain in the hidden habitation of Mine inner Being, forbidden as I may be from divulging that which God hath bestowed upon Me of the wonders of His knowledge, the gems of His wisdom, and the tokens of His power,
prediction: And though I be in those days when the dogs of the earth and the beasts of the land have surrounded me, I would hide within the nest of My secret, and be prevented from revealing that which God hath bestowed upon me of the wondrous knowledge of His wisdom and the jewels of His power and the manifestations of His might.

input: ولکن مع کلّ ذلک ما احبّ ان اخیّب من قام لدی حرم الکبریآء و یرید ان یدخل فی رفرف البقآء و یحبّ ان یطیر فی سمآء هذا البدآء فی فجر القضآء.
output: yet am I loath to frustrate the hopes of one who hath approached the sanctuary of grandeur, sought to enter within the precincts of eternity, and aspired to soar in the immensity of this creation at the dawning of the divine decree.
prediction: Yet, with all this, I desire not to disappoint him who standeth at the threshold of the All-Glorious, and seeketh to enter into the canopy of everlasting life, and yearneth to soar in the heavens of this new creation at the dawn of destiny.

input: لذا اذکر لک بعض ما اکرمنی الله عمّا تطیقه النّفوس و تحمله العقول لئلّا یرفع ضوضآء المبغضین و اعلام المنافقین.
output: I shall therefore relate unto thee certain truths from among those which God hath vouchsafed unto Me, this only to the extent that souls can bear and minds endure, lest the malicious raise a clamour or the dissemblers hoist their banners.
prediction: Therefore, I mention unto Thee some of that which God hath bestowed upon me, beyond that which souls can bear and minds can comprehend, lest the clamor of the haters and the banners of the hypocrites be raised.

input: و اسأل الله بأن یؤیّدنی بذلک اذ هو ارحم الرّاحمین و معطی السّائلین.
output: I implore God to graciously aid Me in this, for unto such as beseech Him, He is the All-Bounteous, and of those who show mercy, He is the Most Merciful.
prediction: I beseech God to strengthen me therein, for He is the Most Merciful of the merciful and the Giver unto the seekers.
